nothing_block.description: The contract's nothing-form for the sentence a model says beside a tool call (GH #871 I-1): one JSON object, rendered as a sidecar fence after such a sentence when it carries no block of its own, so the sentence stands in later windows with a precedent. Empty (the default) = off. A talky runs the value of its splitter's `nothing_block`.

description.purpose: The one writer of the wall: every element that enters the model's window -- a turn of the running round, the model's final answer off the tap, a durable system slot -- becomes a block (once per hash) and a wall row (once per session, turn, hash and copy). Two steps per message against the ledger: park the payload and read what is there in one bundle, then write only what is new.
description.not_in_scope: No window, no model call, no episode shape: it hands the window to `./policy` and the participant turns to `./writer`.
description.emits_meaning: lstore: ledger operations (`hop.phase`, `hop.reply_cell` say who reads the answer). episode: the participant turns just written, for `./writer`. pack_ack: the receipt of a pack.
description.consumes_meaning: The four lanes in_curate, in_slots, in_llm, in_pack, and the ledger's answers to its own two steps.
